capabilities: List hidden folders on disk and enable root dot-folders and nested ones
Reindex enabled hidden paths into the file tree
Reload all enabled community plugins except this one
disambiguation: Not a search-index repair tool; it rescans hidden folders, refreshes the file tree, and reloads plugins from a sidebar pane.
extras: README warns to disable Hidden Folders Access while Nested Hidden Folders is on.
intentEvidence: Use it instead of opening Nested Hidden Folders settings.
problem: Making Obsidian index nested dot-folders normally means toggling settings and restarting, with no single control to rescan, refresh the tree, and reload plugins.

relations.evidence: Use it instead of opening Nested Hidden Folders settings.

summary: Sidebar pane that rescans hidden folders, rebuilds the file tree and metadata cache, and reloads community plugins.
